readerCopy.body: An old fight can come back with enough heat to feel like it never ended. Mars conjunct the South Node can reactivate a familiar conflict, competitive instinct, survival response, or way of forcing movement when you feel blocked. You may know exactly how to push, defend, quit, or take over because that response has protected you before. The anger may still be justified. The important part is noticing when the strategy belongs to an earlier battle. Act on what is actually happening now, not only on what your body remembers.
